datasets.name: M. genitalium parameters
claims: Every fitted scalar constant used by viva-Mgen (mass fractions, cell-cycle durations, metabolite pools, maintenance/exchange bounds) with value, units, and source — the browsable parameter list.

datasets.name: iPS189 metabolic network (Suthers 2009)
claims: The published M. genitalium genome-scale reconstruction (351 reactions, 346 metabolites, 126 genes) the FBA metabolism submodel runs on.

datasets.name: Gene list + reference essentiality
claims: All 525 M. genitalium genes with symbol, name, reference essentiality, and associated metabolic reactions (Karr 2012 knowledge base).

datasets.name: Fitted constants (raw)
claims: Raw states.Mass / states.Time / states.Metabolite / processes.Metabolism parameter blocks extracted verbatim from the Karr 2012 parameters.json.
